notes.title: Mini Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello!

We’ve released a small update for Nekomin Kittens invasion with a few minor fixes.



 Fixes

Corrected typos

Adjusted some models

Other minor bug fixes



With these fixes, the world of Nekomin should now feel even smoother to play.

We hope you’ll drop by and enjoy it again!



We look forward to seeing you in the game, meow!

notes.title: Notice of Multilingual Support Update
notes.content:
Hello! 

This is the Nekomin development team.



We are excited to announce that Nekomin Kittens Invasion has received a multilingual support update!

To make the game enjoyable for even more players, we have added the following languages in addition to Japanese



English

Japanese

Simplified Chinese

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643435/f55d7abd2cda399d7bd161ea3de1301afb2f4f4a.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643435/bbdca3895256fe8f3ff048ac472f1af140d8cb57.png"]

We have taken great care with the translations, but if you happen to notice any mistakes or unnatural expressions, we would appreciate it if you could let us know in the discussion thread.



Thank you for your continued support of Nekomin Kittens Invasion!
